about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Get to know Gala Printing and how we help meet your printing needs.
about.description: We serve a variety of printing needs: stickers, brochures, business cards, banners, and custom orders. Our focus is on quality results, clear processes, and fast communication.
about.canCustomDesc: Upload your own design or consult with us first.
about.clearProcessDesc: Check your order status with the transaction number.
about.faqQ1: Can I order with my own design?
about.faqA1: Yes. There's a file upload feature on the product detail page (mock).
about.faqQ2: What if I don't have a design yet?
about.faqA2: Write your requirements in the "Notes" field and we'll arrange the workflow once the backend is ready.
about.faqQ3: How do I check the status?
about.faqA3: Go to the Order Status page and enter your transaction number.

howToOrder.title: How to Order
howToOrder.subtitle: Simple steps to order printing products at Gala Printing.
howToOrder.step1Desc: Go to the Products page and select the item you want.
howToOrder.step2Desc: Set the quantity, add notes, and adjust other needs if required.
howToOrder.step3Desc: Upload your design file (JPG/JPEG/PNG). In this mock, we save the filename first.
howToOrder.step4Desc: Click "Add to Cart", then check your shopping summary.
howToOrder.step5Desc: Click Checkout (Mock). The system will generate a transaction number to check status.
howToOrder.step6Desc: Enter the transaction number on the Order Status page.
howToOrder.noteDesc: Once the backend is available, the checkout flow will include shipping address, payment method, and automatic notifications.
